study.title: Research on the Corn Stover Image Segmentation Method via an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and Improved U-Net Network
study.short_title: VGG19-U-Net + CBAM corn stover (straw) semantic seg from UAV

segmentation.domain: semantic segmentation of corn stover/straw cover from UAV visible-spectrum imagery for no-till conservation tillage assessment and straw-coverage subsidy measurement (binary: straw vs background)
models_tested: Improved U-Net: VGG19 encoder (ImageNet pretrained, first 5 layers) + CBAM + Focal-Dice Loss (proposed)
segmentation.best_model: Proposed VGG19-U-Net + CBAM + Focal-Dice Loss: mIoU 0.8323, PA 0.9387, Precision 0.9198, Recall 0.9066 (256x256 inputs)

dataset.name: Corn stover dataset (Jianshan Farm, Heihe City, Heilongjiang, China; soybean-following corn field)
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 4 multispectral UAV (six bands: R/G/B/NIR/RGB/red-edge); a 3500-image set from Apr 23-28, 2023 stitched with Agisoft Metashape (80% forward/side overlap, 3 m/s, S-route) to a 14228x14147 orthomosaic, manually cropped, sliced to 256x256 (VOC2007 format) via Photoshop. GSD stated as 0.44 pixels/cm (~2.27 cm/px; derived). Split 6:2:2 = 960 train / 320 val / 320 test; Labelme point-mode pixel annotation; binary masks (red straw / black background); RGB visible band used.

segmentation.backbone: VGG19 encoder (pretrained on ImageNet, transfer learning, first 5 layers) + U-Net decoder with CBAM (CAM+SAM) after each coding convolution; 3x3 kernels, five-stage conv-pooling

mIoU.quote: Table 6: Comparison of segmentation results of four models regarding straw and background ... Our algorithm ... mIoU/% 83.23
mIoU.ambiguity: Validation-set mIoU of proposed model (VGG19+CBAM+Focal-Dice). Ablation: U-Net 73.54, VGG19+U-Net 81.93, +CBAM 82.75, +Focal-Dice 83.23 (Table 4).

F1.ambiguity: F1 not reported; Precision 0.9198 and Recall 0.9066 given for the proposed model (Table 6).

Dice.ambiguity: Dice used only inside the Focal-Dice training loss (Eq. 2); no Dice metric value reported in results.

PA.ambiguity: Pixel accuracy of proposed model (Eq. 4). Ablation: U-Net 85.34, +VGG19 92.66, +CBAM 93.52, +Focal-Dice 93.87. Data-size comparison (Table 2): 256x256 gives 93.87 vs 128x128 88.43 and 512x512 OOM.

weed_F1.ambiguity: No weed class; binary straw/background task.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Living crop not segmented; target is corn-stover residue vs background.

edge.framework: PyTorch 1.7.1, Python 3.7, CUDA 11.0, OpenCV/Numpy/PIL; NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3050 (4 GB), Intel Core i5-1200H, 16 GB RAM; Adam (lr 0.0001), batch 2, 100 epochs, frozen-encoder phase then unfreeze

fps.ambiguity: No inference FPS. Table 2 reports TRAINING throughput in iterations/s at 256x256: proposed 13.35 (GTX 3050), U-Net 12.32, SegNet 12.09, ResNet 6.33; 128x128 fastest (proposed 24.95), 512x512 slowest (and OOM for proposed).

params_M.ambiguity: VGG19 noted as having the largest trainable-parameter count among compared encoders (qualitative; no numeric value).

issues: No efficiency/inference metrics and no edge deployment: iterations/s values are TRAINING throughput on a desktop GeForce GTX 3050, not model inference speed.
Resolution: paper states GSD as '0.44 pixels/cm'; m/px derived (~0.0227 m/px).
mIoU/PA recorded from the proposed-model row of Table 6 (validation set); no independent test-set split values given (test demo on 100 random images, qualitative + Figure 11).
Precision/Recall reported but no F1 or Dice metric value.
512x512 input exceeded proposed model memory (OOM), motivating 256x256.
